and on the bottom screen, near its top edge

cases.desc: the pause opening in a real level (the game turns the hearts' layer off for a frame): the level stays on the top screen, no black frame

checks.what: the top screen still shows the level, not black

cases.desc: the first level after the tutorial's: the trees and pegs above the game's screen on the top screen, the game with its hearts below

checks.what: the top screen shows the level, not the logo's grey

cases.desc: an ice level whose backgrounds the game loads once (not from its tables of map blocks): the icy waterfall goes on above the game's screen, not black

checks.what: the top screen's background is the waterfall's, not black

cases.desc: a time trial whose wall the game draws by code (its table says another picture): the same wall above the game's screen
the top of a desert level (backgrounds loaded once): sand and rocks above the game's screen, not black

checks.what: the top screen has no black band

cases.desc: DK above the camera's top stop in a level whose top is nearer than a screen (camera row under 160): he is on the top screen, climbing on

checks.what: DK on the top screen's lower half, in the sky

cases.desc: the tutorial's first room, a frame after the speech moves on (the game pans its camera that frame, the copy drew the rows of the real one): the top screen keeps the picture it had, not a flash of the ground

checks.what: the top screen is the same on the frame that was drawn wrong

cases.desc: a level wider than the screen scrolled by a part of a tile: the top screen's right edge shows the level, not a black bar

checks.what: the top screen's right edge isn't black

cases.desc: the copy in step (one core) held to every other frame (a device that can't keep up): the top screen's picture moves with the camera on the frames it doesn't run, not the last one again

checks.what: the top screen moves from the first frame to the second (the camera scrolls each one)
and from the second to the third
the level shows, not black

cases.desc: the tutorial moving to its next room (the game fades out, loads, fades in, its camera settling for a dozen frames): both screens stay the level's, black while the game is, the logo not coming back between

checks.what: the second screen is the game's black while the room loads, not the logo
and while its camera settles, with the first screen black beside it
the room fading in on the second screen

cases.desc: the copy on a thread of its own (the default; the tests wait for each picture, none a frame late): its pictures are the ones used, the right edge of a wide level and all

checks.what: the worker drew the pictures shown

checks.what: the top screen's right edge isn't black, from the worker's pictures

cases.desc: the copy in step with the game (one core, or no threads): the same pictures as the worker's, the right edge of a wide level and all

checks.what: no worker
the top screen's right edge isn't black
